cards.front: Geschwind syndrome in temporal lobe epilepsy includes hypergraphia, hyperreligiosity, [___], and viscosity.
cards.context:
Temporal lobe epilepsy (TLE) is an important organic cause of psychosis. Ictal psychosis occurs during seizure activity — often complex partial seizures with automatisms and altered awareness.

Post-ictal psychosis emerges after a lucid interval of 1-7 days following a seizure cluster. Inter-ictal psychosis is a chronic schizophrenia-like psychosis occurring between seizures in long-standing TLE.

Geschwind syndrome describes the inter-ictal personality changes of TLE: hypergraphia (compulsive writing), hyperreligiosity, altered sexuality (usually hyposexuality).

cards.front: The hallmark electrolyte disturbance of refeeding syndrome is a precipitous drop in serum [___].
cards.context: Reintroducing carbohydrate triggers an insulin surge that shifts intracellular electrolytes alongside glucose for ATP synthesis.
